english:
Count of failed attempts to start the kernel-mode driver: $

WARNING!
The CPU polling service uses the kernel-mode driver to get information about the CPU temperature. fpsVR uses a fairly common driver: "WingRing0". Some anti-viruses may block it as not safe. In this case you will see an antivirus warning about the file "hardwareprovider.sys".
fpsVR fixes the existing vulnerability in this driver by setting appropriate access rights. But some antiviruses intercept the driver launch calls and this happens before the permissions are changed and block its work.
If there are 2 or more such blockings in a row, fpsVR will stop attempts to start this driver and the CPU polling service. You can try to start CPU polling again by resetting the counter (restart required).
schinese:
启动内核模式驱动失败的次数：$

警告！
CPU 轮询服务通过内核模式驱动获取 CPU 温度信息。fpsVR 使用的是一个相当常见的驱动：“WinRing0”。部分杀毒软件可能会将其视为不安全而拦截，此时你会看到关于文件“hardwareprovider.sys”的杀毒警告。
fpsVR 通过设置相应的访问权限修复了该驱动已知的漏洞，但有些杀毒软件会在权限修改之前拦截驱动的启动调用并阻止其运行。
如果连续被拦截 2 次或以上，fpsVR 将停止尝试启动该驱动和 CPU 轮询服务。你可以重置计数器后再次尝试启动 CPU 轮询（需要重启）。

english:
Where can I find the in-game overlay? By default overlay is attached to the bottom of the left controller. If you have been using fpsVR for a long time and lost the overlay, then you may have enabled one of the settings that hides the overlay, check the fpsVR settings.

Where can I find the fpsVR settings? If you are reading this, then you are already looking at the fpsVR settings overlay. The fpsVR settings overlay is built into the SteamVR dashboard. In order to open it in VR when you need it, just open the SteamVR dashboard, find a small button on the bottom left that says fpsVR. Clicking on it will take you to the fpsVR settings. There are two ways to open a copy of this overlay on your desktop:
• From the fpsVR desktop window menu, click 'Settings'. If the window is closed, you can double click on the fpsVR icon in the Windows tray (at right bottom corner of desktop, the icon may be hidden, you may need to click the left arrow there to show hidden icons) to open fpsVR desktop window.
• The second way is to right-click on the fpsVR icon in the Windows tray (at right bottom corner of desktop) and call the settings through the icon menu.

fpsVR 设置在哪里？如果你正在阅读这段文字，说明你已经在看 fpsVR 的设置悬浮窗了。fpsVR 设置悬浮窗内置于 SteamVR 仪表盘中。需要在 VR 中打开时，只要打开 SteamVR 仪表盘，在左下角找到写着 fpsVR 的小按钮，点击即可进入 fpsVR 设置。在桌面上打开该悬浮窗副本有两种方法：
• 在 fpsVR 桌面窗口的菜单中点击“设置”。如果窗口已关闭，可以双击 Windows 托盘（桌面右下角，图标可能被隐藏，需要点击那里的箭头显示隐藏的图标）中的 fpsVR 图标打开桌面窗口。
• 第二种方法是右键点击 Windows 托盘（桌面右下角）中的 fpsVR 图标，通过图标菜单打开设置。

english:
Since version 1.24, fpsVR uses the Oculus API to get useful information to display in the in-game overlay when the headset is connected via cable or Airlink (but not when using VD or ALVR). But this does not mean that the fpsVR overlay will be displayed in VR games and applications that uses the Oculus API.

The Oculus API does not support overlays from background apps, and likely never will.
It doesn't matter from which store to launch the VR game or application. There are games on Steam that prefer to use the Oculus API.

To determine if a VR game or app is not using SteamVR, simply try opening the SteamVR dashboard, if you can't open it in VR it means that SteamVR is currently running in the background for the Oculus Software system and is not an active VR app. In this case, it is better to close SteamVR so as not to take up system resources for nothing.
schinese:
从 1.24 版开始，当头显通过有线或 Air Link 连接时（使用 VD 或 ALVR 时除外），fpsVR 会通过 Oculus API 获取有用的信息并显示在游戏内悬浮窗中。但这并不意味着 fpsVR 悬浮窗能在使用 Oculus API 的 VR 游戏和应用中显示。

Oculus API 不支持来自后台应用的悬浮窗，而且很可能永远不会支持。
无论你从哪个商店启动 VR 游戏或应用都一样。Steam 上也有一些游戏优先使用 Oculus API。

要判断一个 VR 游戏或应用是否没有使用 SteamVR，只需尝试打开 SteamVR 仪表盘：如果在 VR 中打不开，说明 SteamVR 此时只是作为 Oculus 软件的后台运行，并不是当前活动的 VR 应用。这种情况下最好关闭 SteamVR，以免白白占用系统资源。

english:
fpsVR - utility for SteamVR for keeping track of FPS, frame time and other performance metrics in the in-game overlay.

fpsVR works with any headset supported by SteamVR.

fpsVR supports any VR games/applications that interact with SteamVR via the following APIs: OpenVR, OpenXR.
Please note that in order to display the fpsVR overlay in VR games/applications using OpenXR, there is an important condition - the current OpenXR runtime must be set to SteamVR (and not to your headset software, such as Mixed Reality Portal or Oculus Software, you can switch the OpenXR runtime in the SteamVR settings)

The Oculus API is only used by fpsVR to get data useful for display in the in-game overlay. The Oculus API does not support overlays from background applications. Therefore, the fpsVR overlay cannot be displayed in VR games and applications, which uses the Oculus API.
schinese:
fpsVR——一款 SteamVR 工具，用于在游戏内悬浮窗中监控 FPS、帧时间及其他性能指标。

fpsVR 支持所有 SteamVR 支持的头显。

fpsVR 支持通过以下 API 与 SteamVR 交互的任何 VR 游戏/应用：OpenVR、OpenXR。
请注意，要在使用 OpenXR 的 VR 游戏/应用中显示 fpsVR 悬浮窗，有一个重要条件——当前的 OpenXR 运行时必须设为 SteamVR（而不是你的头显软件，例如混合现实门户或 Oculus 软件；你可以在 SteamVR 设置中切换 OpenXR 运行时）。

fpsVR 仅使用 Oculus API 获取可在游戏内悬浮窗中显示的数据。Oculus API 不支持来自后台应用的悬浮窗，因此 fpsVR 悬浮窗无法在使用 Oculus API 的 VR 游戏和应用中显示。

english:
This feature is under development. By enabling the option below you will help developers to bring more stats to the fpsVR users, which will allow you to compare performance in VR games and apps with different supersampling settings, GPUs, CPUs, GPU drivers, and VR headsets.

By enabling this option you are AGREEING to send sessions data to fpsvr.net. Most of statistics based on this data will be availble in the near future on www.fpsvr.net and and possibly will be available inside the fpsVR.

Sessions data does NOT include any identification data, personal data, hardware serial numbers that can identify you.

Sessions data does include: Headset/GPU/CPU models and characteristics, RAM size, GPU driver version, frametimes and fps stats, game/app name, session length, session start and end time, Windows and SteamVR versions.
schinese:
此功能仍在开发中。启用下方选项可以帮助开发者为 fpsVR 用户提供更多统计数据，让你能比较不同超采样设置、GPU、CPU、显卡驱动和 VR 头显下 VR 游戏和应用的性能。

启用此选项即表示你同意向 fpsvr.net 发送会话数据。基于这些数据的大部分统计将在不久后于 www.fpsvr.net 上线，也可能会在 fpsVR 内提供。

会话数据不包含任何可识别身份的数据、个人数据或能识别你的硬件序列号。

会话数据包含：头显/GPU/CPU 型号及参数、内存大小、显卡驱动版本、帧时间和 FPS 统计、游戏/应用名称、会话时长、会话开始和结束时间、Windows 和 SteamVR 版本。

fpsVR detected issue with the system performance counters settings. Do you want to fpsVR try to restore this settings?

Yes - fpsVR will launch a fix tool
No - Do nothing and do not ask again
Cancel - Skip and continue, fpsVR will pop up this window next time

fpsVR 检测到系统性能计数器设置有问题。是否让 fpsVR 尝试恢复这些设置？

是 - fpsVR 将启动修复工具
否 - 不做任何操作，且不再询问
取消 - 跳过并继续，下次 fpsVR 还会弹出此窗口
